candidates.title: Govern AI agent tool access with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
candidates.summary: Give your AI agents governed, auditable access to enterprise tools without consolidating infrastructure. This post walks through a four-scope maturity model (Connect, Control, Catalog, and Harden) for building a governed tool gateway with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, advancing only when real governance pain demands it.

candidates.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
candidates.summary: Anthropic forbids its Claude models from generating sexually explicit content. But a series of tests conducted by TechCrunch found that it didn't take much to get past the restriction.

candidates.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
candidates.summary: Nvidia research shows that AI agents can perform well, and not go off the deep end, through fine-tuning, even if the AI model isn't that great at the task.

candidates.title: Agentic Data Operations Platform (ADOP): Data engineering into hours
candidates.summary: The Agentic Data Operations Platform (ADOP) is a reference architecture on Amazon Bedrock that uses specialized AI agents to automate the full Bronze-to-Silver-to-Gold data pipeline lifecycle, compressing new-source onboarding from weeks to hours while keeping data governance and compliance controls inline.
